reviews.review: I like the look: each stage has its own colour, the ghost glows, and spikes, saws and lasers are easy to read. But First Steps left the mid player standing in front of a small spike patch for 45 seconds, and getting stuck on stage 1 would make me close the tab. Saw Mill killed a player after 2.1 seconds, which felt cheap for stage 3, and Gauntlet's laser wall at 67% stops most people. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate felt fair and fun. Spring Loaded is pretty, but nobody died, so it had no tension. Ferry Lines has many pit deaths below the screen.
reviews.best: Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are clear, fair and have just enough danger.
reviews.worst: Saw Mill kills you two seconds in, and First Steps can leave a player stuck in front of spikes on stage 1.

reviews.review: The curve is a zigzag, not a ramp. First Steps lets my mid-skill run stand in front of a spike pair for 45 seconds, which is a bad first lesson. Saw Mill kills at 2 seconds with two moving saws before it teaches one, and only 27% pass at stage 3. Spring Loaded then has zero deaths, so the springs carry no risk. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are the best: one mechanic, clear telegraph, readable deaths. Gauntlet mixes all mechanics well, but the laser at 67% stacks most deaths in one spot and reads as a timing trap.
reviews.best: Laser Gate teaches the blinking beams on flat ground first and then adds spikes and a saw, with deaths spread out and readable.
reviews.worst: Saw Mill is a stage 3 difficulty wall that kills a mid-skill player with a saw in the first two seconds.

reviews.review: The curve is broken for me. Saw Mill is stage 3 and kills the mid player in 2.1 seconds with saws at jump height right off the spawn; 27% pass there is a wall, not a lesson. Then Spring Loaded is 100 of 100 with zero deaths, so it is a cutscene with no line to optimise. Gauntlet stacks one laser at 67% that eats most runs, which reads as a timing lottery. First Steps left a player frozen before a small spike for 45 seconds. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are the good ones: readable hazards, real risk, fast flow.
reviews.best: Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate give fast, readable routes where a death is clearly my own mistake.
reviews.worst: Spring Loaded has no risk at all, while Saw Mill at stage 3 kills in two seconds before I can read the saw cycle.

git.subject: v5: make the too-hard stages easier (2, 3, 4, 7, 8)
git.body:
Measurement (v4), mid-skill pass: stage 2 21.3%, stage 3 28.0%,
stage 4 45.3%, stage 7 57.3%, stage 8 22.7% (target 60-80%).
- stage 2: 82 timeouts at tile 66 (2-tile ledge, then 3 spikes, no run-up):
  ledge 2 -> 4 tiles. 46 spike deaths under the low ceiling: 2 spikes -> 1.
- stage 3: saw deaths at tiles 8 (65), 30 (45), 39-42: saw periods
  100/90/110 -> 150 frames; the two bobbing saws 3 -> 5 tiles apart.
- stage 4: 48 pit deaths at the first ferry: ferry 3 -> 4 tiles wide.
  Twin ferries 2 -> 3 tiles wide. Saw on the last ferry line: period
  120 -> 180 frames.
- stage 7: 117 laser deaths at laser 2 (27 of them high-skill). It goes on
  at frame 120, when a full-speed player gets there (frames 108-153).
  Phase moved by 60 frames, so it is already on when the player comes.
- stage 8: 139 deaths at tiles 64-69 (laser, then saw 2 tiles later, then
  3 spikes): 4 tiles between laser and saw, saw period 120 -> 180,
  spikes 3 -> 2. First ferry 2 -> 3 tiles wide.
